findings.finding: A resale registration for 157.5M shares by Smart Mart Limited has been effective since 2026-09-16. That is about 119x the 1,321,418 Class A shares outstanding. The investor's purchase price resets to 50% of the lowest close, so every new low cheapens its next purchase and keeps the selling going into the 2026-10-07 session.
findings.mechanism_in_window: The registration is already effective, so shares bought under it can be sold on the 2026-10-07 session with no further filing. Today's close is a new 52-week low (pos_52w 0.0). That close becomes the lowest-close reference, which cuts the investor's purchase price to about half of it. Its arbitrage against market is then at its widest overnight.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: After its 19 comparable falls this name rose the next day only 36.8% of the time (median -5.96%). In the July to August episode, after the facility was signed (2026-07-03), three consecutive comparable falls continued (07-22 -24.6%, 07-23 -83.5%, then 08-05 -45.5% followed by -19.4%).
findings.why_not_priced: Today's 33% fall prices the selling that has already happened, not the supply still registered. The registered amount is about 119x the float, and the investor has a 50% discount that resets lower with the price, so it has no reason to stop. If the price held this, the stock would not still be trading at about 2x the investor's effective purchase price.
findings.independence: The 2026-07-06 6-K gives the pricing formula and the $0.20 floor (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1723980/000121390026075528/ea0296876-6k_chinasxt.htm). The 2026-08-28 6-K shows the company moved the floor back to $0.20 from $16 (https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1723980/000121390026095147/ea0303801-6k_china.htm). Both are the issuer's own documents, so this is not independent of the issuer.

findings.finding: Twice in 2026 a comparable fall came the day before a registered direct offering announced under the company's effective shelf: the 2026-01-08 -37.5% fall before the $10m RDO on 01-09 (next close -87.9%), and the 2026-07-22 -24.6% fall before the $9m RDO on 07-23 (next close -83.5%). A repeat could price tonight.
findings.mechanism_in_window: In both cases the issuer announced an RDO on the session after a comparable fall. The base shelf (F-3 filed 2025-11-10, effective 2025-12-01) has already carried takedowns on 01-12, 04-09, 06-01 and 07-24 (424B5s), so an announcement tonight would land before the 2026-10-07 close.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: From the baseline: the two RDO-announcement sessions closed -87.92% (2026-01-09) and -83.51% (2026-07-23).
findings.why_not_priced: No offering has been announced, so the close cannot hold one. This is a probability-weighted size: about 2 of the 12 listed comparable falls were followed by an RDO, against an 80%+ drop when one lands. It is cut heavily because the remaining shelf capacity at a ~$1.8m market cap is unverified (baby-shelf limits) and the Smart Mart facility may stand in for an RDO.
findings.independence: The news dates come from a second source, StockTitan's news list: RDOs announced 2026-01-09 and 2026-07-23 (https://www.stocktitan.net/news/SXTC/). The fall dates and next-day moves come from the sealed baseline's Yahoo bars.

outside_window.finding: Another share consolidation becomes likely if the price falls under $1. There were consolidations announced 2025-02-21, 2026-01-30 and 2026-08-05 (1-for-80, effective 08-10). Nothing has been announced and there is no bid-price notice yet ($1.39).
The Smart Mart facility can draw further tranches of $0.25m to $3m until about 2028-07. Each draw adds supply at a 50%-of-lowest-close price.
